test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: ________________ controllers uses compressed air to control Central Industrial Air Conditioning Systems.
solution:
The correct answer is __Pneumatic**(Pneumatic Controllers)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pneumatic controllers__ utilize compressed air as the control medium.
 
• Pneumatic systems are highly reliable and widely used in industrial applications.
 
• The compressed air provides precise control over various mechanical processes in air conditioning systems.
 
• Pneumatic controllers are preferred due to their durability and ease of maintenance.
 
• They are often used in hazardous environments where electrical components may not be suitable.
 
• The technology offers cost-effectiveness and is energy efficient.
 
• Pneumatic systems are versatile and can be used in various industrial applications, including HVAC systems.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydraulic Controllers:**
 
 
• Hydraulic systems use fluid pressure for operation and are typically used in heavy machinery.
 
• They provide high force but are not suitable for air conditioning systems.
 
 
 
• **Robotic Controllers:**
 
 
• Robotic controllers are used in robotics for precise motion control.
 
• They are not applicable to central air conditioning systems.
 
 
 
• **Automated Controllers:**
 
 
• Automated controllers are used in various automated processes but do not specifically use compressed air.
 
• They often rely on electronic systems for operation.
